The '''Garfin system''' was a part of the [[Immeria sector/Legends|Immeria sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Garfin]]''.<ref name="VoF">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Garfin [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-14.<ref name="TEA" />
